description: This file contains the implementation of font management functions using FreeType and OpenGL in C, including loading, measuring, rendering, and cleanup of fonts.

methods.name: void lu5_init_freetype(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Initializes the FreeType library within the lu5_State context.

methods.name: int lu5_load_font(lu5_State * l5,lu5_font ** fontId,const char * fontPath)
methods.description: Loads a font from a file path or default font into a lu5_font object, setting up glyph textures.

methods.name: lu5_font * lu5_load_and_add_font(lu5_State * l5,const char * font_path)
methods.description: Loads a font from a specified path, adds it to the font list, and returns the font object.

methods.name: void lu5_measure_text(const char * text,int * width,int * height,int * max_bearing_y,lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Measures the width, height, and maximum bearing of a given text string using a specific font.

methods.name: void lu5_render_text(const char * text,float x,float y,float fontSize,int textAlign,lu5_font * font,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the specified text at a given position, size, and alignment using a font.

methods.name: void lu5_load_default_font(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Loads the default font statically during initialization.

methods.name: void lu5_close_font(lu5_font * font)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a font, such as textures and FreeType face.

methods.name: void lu5_close_fonts(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Cleans up all fonts and FreeType resources associated with the lu5_State.
